newsitem.title: USA: Dal-Tile says lower 97 revs to hurt Q1.
newsitem.headline: Dal-Tile says lower 97 revs to hurt Q1.

text.p: Dal-Tile International Inc said Thursday revenues in company-owned sales centers were below expected levels for the first two months of the year and will result in first quarter revenues falling below anticipated levels.
The sales centers represent the largest of its distribution channels, the company said.

While first quarter revenues are expected to approximate those of 1996, the shortfall from expected 1997 revenues is expected to hurt first quarter earnings by about $0.09 to $0.12 per share, it said.
It said that the lower-than-expected revenues are mainly due to the transition relating to the integration of the company's information systems, following the acquisition of American Olean Tile Co.
The delay in the integration is expected to hurt full year 1997 results, it said.
